description: Version-controlled evidence registry. Sources are recorded with the strongest identifier obtained. IMPORTANT ACCESS CONSTRAINT (Stage 2): this build environment's network proxy blocks all direct HTTPS fetches (WebFetch and curl both return 403 CONNECT-tunnel-failed) to publishers, PMC, arXiv, and even NCBI E-utilities. Only server-side WebSearch is available, which returns AI summaries. Per the Stage-2 no-fabrication policy, AI summaries are used ONLY to IDENTIFY sources, never as verified quantitative evidence. Therefore every source below is marked full_text_opened=false and any numbers seen in search summaries are NOT recorded here as data. See docs/full-text-access-log.md and docs/critical-paywalled-sources.md.

field_notes.identity_verified: true if title/authors/journal/year/identifier were returned by a search listing (bibliographic identity), NOT that the full text was read
field_notes.full_text_opened: true only if the original full text was actually opened and inspected in this session (always false in Stage 2 due to the access block)
field_notes.quantitative_data_extracted: true only if specific values were read from the source with an exact locator (none in Stage 2)

sources.title: Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Analyses — Format and Content, Guidance for Industry
Open Systems Pharmacology Suite (PK-Sim, MoBi)

sources.title: Analysis of nanoparticle delivery to tumours
sources.authors: Wilhelm S, Tavares AJ, Dai Q, Ohta S, Audet J, Dvorak HF, Chan WCW
sources.role: context/limitations anchor (median ~0.7% ID tumour delivery); NOT a diffusion parameter

sources.title: Tumor Vascular Permeability, Accumulation, and Penetration of Macromolecular Drug Carriers
sources.authors: Dreher MR, Liu W, Michelich CR, Dewhirst MW, Yuan F, Chilkoti A
sources.role: candidate quantitative source for tumour vascular permeability vs MW and interstitial penetration depth; rodent window-chamber, dextran carriers (not released API). Values require full-text verification.

sources.title: Predicting Skin Permeability
sources.role: model form for skin permeability coefficient from logKow and MW (a correlation, applies to API not intact nanoparticle). Coefficients require full-text verification.

sources.title: Test No. 428: Skin Absorption: In Vitro Method
sources.role: standardized in vitro (Franz cell) skin-absorption methodology anchor for a skin candidate

sources.title: Comparison of protocols measuring diffusion and partition coefficients in the stratum corneum
sources.role: candidate source for stratum-corneum D and K values (API). Values require full-text verification.

sources.title: Franz Cell Diffusion Testing and Quantitative Confocal Raman Spectroscopy: In Vitro-In Vivo Correlation
sources.role: candidate IVIVC evidence for skin permeation (reported strong correlation); values require full-text verification

sources.title: Nano-Formulation Based Intravesical Drug Delivery Systems (review)
sources.role: entry point to intravesical bladder-wall penetration literature; primary quantitative sources must be traced and opened

sources.title: Evaluation of NanoDoce (docetaxel nanoparticle) in Participants With Urothelial Carcinoma
sources.role: clinical-stage nanoparticle for a local (intravesical) route; formulation/PK details require source access

sources.title: Size-Dependent Penetration of Nanoparticles in Tumor Spheroids (transcellular/paracellular)
sources.role: candidate in vitro quantitative NP penetration-depth data in spherical geometry (matches solver); measures carrier, not released API

pending.note: No tissue-specific numeric parameters have been added to any profile. Quantitative extraction is blocked by the environment's network policy. To advance any candidate to parameterization, the full texts in docs/critical-paywalled-sources.md must be provided (PDF upload) or a networked environment enabled.
